{{DISPLAYTITLE:SaintapediaFeedback}}
= SaintapediaFeedback =

Readers can suggest improvements from the floating '''Improve this article''' button on main-namespace pages. Editors triage that feedback at [[Special:SaintapediaFeedback]].

This page is the operator cheat-sheet: who can see what, which <code>MediaWiki:</code> pages exist, and what belongs in LocalSettings instead. It lives in the Project namespace so the widget (default namespaces: main only) does not appear on it, and so it stays out of article search / Special:AllPages / random article.

== For readers ==

* The widget is on main-namespace articles. Hide it for this tab with × or a long-press; restore from the screen-edge tab or '''Tools → Improve this article'''.
* Submissions are anonymous by default (public mode). hCaptcha and a per-IP rate limit apply.
* Public resolutions (curated summaries, not raw comments) live at <code>Special:SaintapediaFeedback/resolutions/&lt;pageid&gt;</code>.

== For editors ==

Dashboard: [[Special:SaintapediaFeedback]] (or Toolbox → '''Page feedback''' on an article).

{| class="wikitable"
! Right
! Default
! What it does
|-
| <code>saintapediafeedback-view</code>
| sysop
| Open the dashboard, process rows, bulk-action. Also granted by [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-access]].
|-
| <code>saintapediafeedback-viewemail</code>
| sysop
| See the optional contact-email field. Independent of dashboard access. [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-email-access]]
|-
| <code>saintapediafeedback-export</code>
| sysop
| Download JSON export. Independent of dashboard access. [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-export-access]]
|}

A block revokes dashboard access immediately, even for sysop.

'''Locking email or export to nobody''' takes two steps: revoke the sysop right in LocalSettings '''and''' put a dummy token such as <code>no-one</code> on the matching access page. An empty page is not "nobody" — it falls back to sysop.

== On-wiki config pages ==

All of these live in the MediaWiki namespace (<code>editinterface</code> only). One value per line; <code>#</code> comments, blank lines, and a leading wiki-list <code>*</code> are ignored. Save/delete/move invalidates the cache immediately (no hour wait).

'''If a page is missing or empty, LocalSettings / PHP defaults apply.''' Leave a page blank unless you intend to override.

=== Access (who) ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Page
! Format
! Default when empty
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-access]]
| one group/token per line: <code>sysop</code>, <code>user</code> (named accounts, not temps), <code>*</code> (everyone — do not use on a public wiki)
| sysop
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-email-access]]
| same
| sysop
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-export-access]]
| same
| sysop
|}

=== Operational knobs ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Page
! Format
! Default when empty
! On a cache/DB read failure
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-ratelimit]]
| non-negative integer. '''<code>0</code> rejects every submit''' (not unlimited). Delete the page to revert to PHP.
| public: 5 / IP / day
| PHP value. Log: <code>using PHP value</code>
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-notify-users]]
| one username per line
| LocalSettings list
| PHP value. Log: <code>using PHP value</code>
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-require-captcha]]
| <code>true</code> / <code>false</code> (also yes/on/1, no/off/0)
| public mode: required
| '''Captcha stays required.''' Log: <code>failing closed</code>
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-show-public-counts]]
| <code>true</code> / <code>false</code>
| off
| PHP value. Log: <code>using PHP value</code>
|-
| [[MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-enable-talklink]]
| <code>true</code> / <code>false</code>
| on
| PHP value. Log: <code>using PHP value</code>
|}

Captcha-required and the rate-limit page are '''security controls'''. Anyone with <code>editinterface</code> can change them without a deploy. On a public wiki keep those two pages '''blank''' and set the values in LocalSettings.

Do '''not''' put the hCaptcha secret or the LLM webhook token on a MediaWiki page. Those pages are world-readable.

== Recommended starting contents (dev) ==

Leave every page above uncreated on a first deploy. PHP defaults are the public-safe set.

If you later want a commented rate-limit override (only after accepting the security tradeoff):

<pre>
# Submissions per hashed IP per day. 0 = reject every submit.
# Delete this page to revert to LocalSettings.
5
</pre>

== PHP warnings to grep ==

During an overlay read failure, PHP logs one of:

* <code>SaintapediaFeedback: wiki-config read failed for SaintapediaFeedbackRequireCaptchaPage; failing closed.</code>
* <code>SaintapediaFeedback: wiki-config read failed for SaintapediaFeedbackRateLimitPage; using PHP value.</code> (and the same suffix for notify-users, show-public-counts, enable-talklink)

Email/export access-page failures log <code>userCanViewEmail overlay read failed; denying</code> / <code>userCanExport overlay read failed; denying</code>. A general cache outage still 500s the dashboard from <code>userCanManage()</code> — that path is not fail-closed.
